warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Write five questions before casting. With reliable binary answers, five questions can distinguish up to 32 mutually exclusive possibilities; unknown or ambiguous answers break that calculation.
Allow one minute for normal casting or 11 minutes as a ritual. Ritual Adept permits a Wizard to read it from the spellbook without preparing it.
The caster makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. Failure deals 6d6 Psychic damage and leaves the caster Incapacitated until a Long Rest ends, unless Greater Restoration removes the effect.
Ask about facts the contacted entity could know. Do not treat a sequence of leading questions as an omniscient search engine. Use the worked example in Chapter 37.
